usage: speechloom serve [-h] [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--allow-remote]
                        [--allow-root ALLOW_ROOT]
                        [--allow-origin ALLOW_ORIGIN]
                        [--max-upload-mb MAX_UPLOAD_MB]
                        [--queue-size QUEUE_SIZE]
                        [--media-workers MEDIA_WORKERS]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --host HOST
  --port PORT
  --allow-remote
  --allow-root ALLOW_ROOT
                        Allow local-path jobs below this root (repeatable)
  --allow-origin ALLOW_ORIGIN
                        Allow this browser origin (repeatable)
  --max-upload-mb MAX_UPLOAD_MB
  --queue-size QUEUE_SIZE
  --media-workers MEDIA_WORKERS
